_meta.purpose: S3·U1 relief-supply fixture (FR-D6-2, FEATURE_D6_SUPPLIES). Each row is fed through the REAL makeSupplyFields factory (src/application/aggregate/supplies.ts), so every invariant (integer quantity, quantity-requires-unit, closed unit enum, parseable expiry) holds on the fixture itself — a lot that could not exist in production is not a fixture.
_meta.provenance: HAND-SEEDED demo stock. There is no supply source adapter in BEACON; GET /supplies serves this as MOCK and says so in provenance[] (Art. XVI: never claim LIVE for seeded data).
_meta.privacy: Art. XIV / ADR-035 §4 — a lot is STOCK. No donor, no payment, no recipient, no person anywhere in this file (the quantity field is deliberately `quantity`, never `amount`).
_meta.clock: fixed — expiry instants sit after the project's fixed test instant 2026-07-05T22:00:00Z, except the water lot, which is deliberately already expired to exercise the labelled-expiry render path
